description: The Synapse module's analytics forwarder -> admin-dash-api POST /api/internal/matrix-events. Auth: 'Authorization: Bearer <analytics_forward.secret>' (compared in constant time). The ingest commits the whole body in one transaction and answers 200 with the response body only AFTER that commit; the module moves its cursor and clears the delivered profiles only on that exact answer. Any other answer is retried, forever, with the same or a superset batch, so every write must be idempotent. A 401/403 is a configuration error. One bad record must not fail the batch: the ingest stores it as a reject, counts it in 'rejected', and still answers 200.

events.description: Forwarded events above the previous cursor, oldest first, at most batch_max (200). State types arrive only as state (state_key a string); pangea.construct only as a timeline event (state_key null). Never outliers or rejected events. May be empty (heartbeat).

stream_pos.description: Synapse stream_ordering; the ordering key for every upsert (state mirror: newer stream_pos wins).

content.description: As stored; a redacted event arrives with its pruned content.

profiles.description: Users whose global profile changed and is not yet acknowledged, each with their WHOLE current profile. Apply only a revision newer than the stored one.

profile.description: displayname, avatar_url and every custom field (pangea.analytics_profile among them), as GET /profile returns it; null when the user has no profile (deleted).

delivered_through.description: Every forwarded event at or below this stream position is in this batch or an earlier acknowledged one. Store as ingest_state.delivered_through, raised never lowered, and ECHO it in the answer.

profiles_clean_before.description: Milliseconds (module clock). Every profile change older than this has been delivered once this batch commits. Raise ingest_state.profiles_clean_before to it, never lower. Very low (<= 0) after a module restart until every profile has been re-sent.

accept_join_pos.description: The stream position of a join the module made for a consented analytics invite before sending this batch. Raise ingest_state.accept_fence to it in the same commit.

pending_accepts.description: Consented analytics invites whose join the module could not make yet (it retries them on its own, at most once per poll). The FULL current set on every batch, not a delta: replace the stored set with it ONLY when pending_accepts_rev is newer than the stored rev. While a (room, teacher) pair is in it, a Refresh of any course that teacher administers must not be reported complete (ingest_lagging); delivery of everything else is not held back.

pending_accepts_rev.description: Grows whenever the module's owed-join set changes; durable across module restarts (stored before any batch carrying it is sent, and moved past on start). Replace the stored pending_accepts only when this is greater than the stored rev, so an older request landing late (after a newer heartbeat with the same delivered_through) cannot overwrite a newer set.

delivered_through.description: Echo of the request's delivered_through. Anything else is not an acknowledgement.

rejected.description: Records of this batch set aside in matrix_ingest_rejects. Optional, 0 when absent.

analytics_state_endpoint.notes: Each known room's COMPLETE current state of the forwarded state types (an absent type is absent from the room, not unread); null for a room this homeserver does not know. Each profile carries a revision bumped by this read, so it is newer than anything pushed before it. At most 500 room ids and 500 user ids per request.
